item.title: Carl x account hack
item.description:
AI does a good job of impersonating friends in DMs. I clicked and fell. Better to verify in other ways before clicking. Brought up a page that looked like my twitter got logged out. Should have suspected right there. Later tried to change pwd immediately but too late. Filed complaints but no use.

so you tried to log into the same page, and they got your credentials?

Yup, real stupid, but was tired.
